answer: Each agent locks 60 credits and plants a willow sapling. Each honest epoch grows one willow ring, checked by a randomly drawn lantern-keeper. Five rings cross the bridge into rewards; each binds one key in the lantern log, and a duplicate hash burns the bond. First ring 36, kth 36+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 240,000 and lock 60,000 vs a 40,000 pool. Rented rings fail: keepers are random. Honest agents pay once and keep every reward.
